The game renders a wider or narrower view to match. Changes apply the next time the game starts.
Native is the original 400×240. 2× is sharp on most handhelds; 3× (1200×720) looks best on 1080p screens but needs a fast GPU.
Auto hides them while a controller is connected. When hidden, the screen only reacts to the game\'s menu elements.
Controller reports A on the right (Nintendo layout)
Press the face button on the RIGHT side of your controller (where A is on a 3DS).
R2 opens the tool ring while you stand still: point with the left stick, A takes a tool out or puts the one in hand away, B closes it.
Stack items when picking them up

Fruit, turnips, bell bags and stationery go onto a matching stack in your pockets, like when you drag them together yourself. A full pocket can still take an item that fits on a stack. Saves stay exactly as the game writes them.
Leaf reads your game and keeps your town in the folder you chose. Android needs "All files access" for the fast storage path used by the emulator core. Turn it on for Leaf on the next screen.
